direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail only / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions preserved: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; animated flow only along feasible real routes; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checking provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald with living flow and state glow, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it, layered depth and soft shadows; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main and shrink the evidence zone so stations, jobs and routes gain cinematic depth and visible material flow.
Raise all scene body copy to 16px and reduce the opening-story logo panel height so the Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 mismatch reads first.
Add bidirectional highlighting between Certificate, Receiving and source-evidence callouts with a 2px emerald focus ring on SVG nodes.
Add a separate Connection readiness zone checking provider identity above the Investigation evidence task, each with its own heading, status and control.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main; the empty lower side zone currently wastes viewport height at 1366x768.
Make route choice explicit on the SVG with selectable feasible routes, state glow and one 240ms trace after selection.
Enlarge the scene and align the three side-zone path controls with the three scene options so bidirectional highlighting confirms the same path.
Set path names and Select this path labels to at least 16px and keep finish and cost metrics tabular at 18px or above.
Add depth and a short cinematic route trace to the selected feasible path only, static under reduced motion.
On selection, open the typed consent form as the dominant side-zone state with the selected plan, typed field and one primary clearly grouped.
Remove the duplicate approval emphasis by keeping one primary in the action bar and a secondary summary in the side zone.
Highlight Split available capacity in both scene and comparison zones with matching emerald glow and focus ring.
Label the proposed tasks more strongly as PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on each dashed card, not only in the header.
Replace misleading progress bars on unapproved tasks with an Awaiting approval marker, since no tracked progress exists yet.
Enlarge task cards within the scene zone and add subtle depth so the three-step sequence reads as a living plan.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 preview in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text in both the banner and machine card.
Animate the feasible route rerouting away from CELL-MILL-2 once on state change, then hold static; remove flow under reduced motion.
Raise the machine selector and consequence copy to 16px and give the selector a visible emerald focus ring.
Separate Connection readiness for provider identity from the Investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status and controls in the side zone.
Make the silver cross-hatching and cross marker on OFFLINE CELL-MILL-2 fully legible without obscuring its name, 0h and replan text.
Show 3 to 2 feasible paths as an emerald route count on the SVG and extinguish any route through the offline cell.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained with silver hatching and plain text while keeping Use verified substitute as the sole emerald selected path.
Bring the revised consent entry into view by tightening the comparison zone inside its reserved area and keeping one action-bar primary.
Add a cinematic trace along the verified-substitute route after selection, with reduced-motion static equivalent.
Keep the 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visually separate below the 3 PROPOSED replacements, with plain Blocked text and hatching distinct from dashed untracked proposals.
Replace progress bars on proposed replacements with Awaiting approval markers until human approval begins tracking.
Enlarge the station and job zones toward 70% scene fill and add state glow only to CELL-MILL-1 on the accepted plan.
Make Verify ledger the single emerald primary and demote Seal and Retain cards to silver LOCKED states until their sequence unlocks.
Reduce the three oversized empty proof cards and enlarge the 70 parts, 35h and 48h outcome metrics within the scene zone.
Raise side-zone instructional copy to 16px and keep the passphrase field, status and next action grouped without overlap.

Restore running machines visually: only stopped machines should carry silver cross-hatching, cross markers and OFFLINE text, while running machines use silver bodies with emerald state glow and living flow between departments.
Fix truncated department text and enlarge machine icons and counts to at least 16px labels so every machine is legible at 1366x768.
Add cinematic department-to-department route traces for the feasible recovery only, with depth, glow and a reduced-motion static map.
Move the live demo link and the five-step judge sequence above the partner table so impact and presentation order land in the first viewport.
Enlarge or refit the embedded full-shop image so machine states are legible instead of a dark miniature, and caption it as the cascade step.
Preserve exactly the header-equivalent opening logo placement here, tighten the hero copy to one promise plus one proof sentence, and set body copy to at least 16px.
